rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken way to say that a word has multiple syllables.

example.english: This English word has multiple syllables, so it is polysyllabic and sounds quite smooth.
example.traditional: 呢個英文單字有多個音節，讀起上嚟幾順口。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jing1 man2 daan1 zi6 jau5 do1 go3 jam1 zit3 duk6 hei2 soeng5 lai4 gei2 seon6 hau2

rows.note: Use this concise technical label, especially when describing a word in a formal or linguistic context.

example.english: In linguistic terms, this is a polysyllabic word.
example.jyutping: ci2 seot6 jyu5 suk6 do1 jam1 zit3 ci4
